from dataclasses import dataclass

from langchain.agents import create_agent

@dataclass
class Context:
    user_name: str

agent = create_agent(
    model="gpt-5-nano",
    tools=[...],
    context_schema=Context  
)

agent.invoke(
 {"messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "What's my name?"}]},
    context=Context(user_name="John Smith")
)
